Each action writes its effect into #status so a read tool can confirm it end-to-end.

handle_dialog — arm BEFORE clicking, or the native dialog blocks the tab

file_upload — set a file into this input

drag_and_drop — drag #dragSrc onto #dropZone

DRAG ME (#dragSrc)
DROP HERE (#dropZone)

click — right-click / double-click

right-click me (#rcTarget)
double-click me (#dcTarget)
